theorem pbEntryC_sat [package_sem' : raftpb.Assumptions] [package_sem : Assumptions] : pbEntryM.Sat

theorem PbModelC.mk.congr_simp.{u_1} (toPbType : PbType GF) (C : Type) (roC roC✝ : Loc → C → IProp
    GF) (e_roC : roC = roC✝) (roC_persistent : ∀ (l : Loc) (c : C), Persistent (roC l c)) (modelOf
    modelOf✝ : C → toPbType.M) (e_modelOf : modelOf = modelOf✝) (levels levels✝ : C → List
    (FieldSchema × List w8)) (e_levels : levels = levels✝) (size size✝ : C → Nat) (e_size : size =
    size✝) (tree tree✝ : toPbType.M → VTree) (e_tree : tree = tree✝) (decOk decOk✝ : C → Prop)
    (e_decOk : decOk = decOk✝) (ro_iff : ∀ (l : Loc) (m : toPbType.M), toPbType.ro l m ⊣⊢ ∃ c, roC l
    c ∗ ⌜modelOf c = m⌝) (roC_ufValid : ∀ (l : Loc) (c : C), roC l c ⊢ ⌜∀ (p : FieldSchema × List
    w8), p ∈ levels c → ufWire p.fst p.snd⌝) (decC decC✝ : Loc → C → IProp GF) (e_decC : decC =
    decC✝) (decC_dec : ∀ (l : Loc) (c : C), decOk c → decC l c ⊢ toPbType.dec l (modelOf c)) : {
    toPbType := toPbType, C := C, roC := roC, roC_persistent := roC_persistent, modelOf := modelOf,
    levels := levels, size := size, tree := tree, decOk := decOk, ro_iff := ro_iff, roC_ufValid :=
    roC_ufValid, decC := decC, decC_dec := decC_dec } = { toPbType := toPbType, C := C, roC := roC✝,
    roC_persistent := ⋯, modelOf := modelOf✝, levels := levels✝, size := size✝, tree := tree✝, decOk
    := decOk✝, ro_iff := ⋯, roC_ufValid := ⋯, decC := decC✝, decC_dec := ⋯ }

axiom entryEncC_ok (c : EntryC) : ufWire entrySchema c.uf → entrySize c < 2 ^ 63 → EntWireOk c.model
    (entryEncC c) ∧ (entryEncC c).length = entrySize c

theorem optCell_freeze [package_sem' : raftpb.Assumptions] [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type}
    [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (x : V) : ⌜p = null ∧ x = zero_val V⌝ ∨ typedPointsto p
    x (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |==> ∃ o, optCell p o ∗ ⌜o.getD (zero_val V) = x⌝

def entryTree (e : EntryM) : VTree :=
  VTree.strct raftpb.Entry.ty
    [(go!"Term", go.uint64.PointerType), (go!"Index", go.uint64.PointerType),
      (go!"Type", raftpb.EntryType.ty.PointerType), (go!"Data", go.byte.SliceType)]
    [cellTree go.uint64 e.Term', cellTree go.uint64 e.Index', cellTree raftpb.EntryType.ty e.Type',
      bytesTree go.byte e.Data']

theorem pbEntry_blank (l : Loc) : pbEntry.blank l = typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry)
    (DFrac.own 1)

theorem pbEntry_dec (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : pbEntry.dec l e = entRO l e

theorem pbEntryC_wire : pbEntryC.data.wire = EntWireOk

def EntWireOk (e : EntryM) (bs : List w8) : Prop :=
  entDecode bs = some e

def pbEntryM : PbModelC GF :=
  { ty := raftpb.Entry.ty, M := EntryM, ro := fun l e => iprop(∃ c, entRoC l c ∗ ⌜c.model = e⌝), ro_persistent := ⋯,
    marshals := fun x => True, wire := EntWireOk, eqv := fun e e' => e = e',
    blank := fun l => typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry) (DFrac.own 1),
    dec := fun l e => iprop(∃ c, entPtsCC l (DFrac.own 1) c ∗ ⌜c.model = e⌝), C := EntryC, roC := entRoC,
    roC_persistent := ⋯, modelOf := EntryC.model, levels := fun c => [(entrySchema, c.uf)], size := entrySize,
    tree := entryTree, decOk := fun x => True, ro_iff := ⋯, roC_ufValid := ⋯,
    decC := fun l c => entPtsCC l (DFrac.own 1) c, decC_dec := ⋯ }

def (sealed) entDecode (bs : List w8) : Option EntryM

axiom pbEntryC_reg [GoGlobalContext] [go.Semantics] : pbModelOf GF raftpb.Entry.ty = some pbEntryC

theorem pbEntryC_ufValid (c : EntryC) : pbEntryC.data.ufValid c = ∀ (q : FieldSchema × List w8), q ∈
    [(entrySchema, c.uf)] → ufWire q.fst q.snd

def pbEntryC : PbTypeC GF :=
  { data := pbEntryM, encd := { enc := entryEncC, enc_ok := ⋯ } }

theorem pbEntry_M : pbEntry.M = EntryM

theorem treeWp_entryPtr [package_sem' : raftpb.Assumptions] [package_sem : Assumptions] (e : EntryM)
    (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (∀ p, entRO p e -∗ Φ (intoVal p)) ⊢ treeWp (VTree.ptr raftpb.Entry.ty
    (entryTree e)) Φ

theorem entPtsCC_freeze (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : EntryC) : entPtsCC l dq c ⊢ |==> entRoC l c

def pbEntry : PbType GF :=
  { ty := raftpb.Entry.ty, M := EntryM, ro := fun l e => entRO l e, ro_persistent := ⋯, marshals := fun x => True,
    wire := EntWireOk, eqv := fun e e' => e = e', blank := fun l => typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry) (DFrac.own 1),
    dec := fun l e => entRO l e }

theorem pbEntry_ro (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : pbEntry.ro l e = entRO l e

theorem pbEntryC_decC (l : Loc) (c : EntryC) : pbEntryC.data.decC l c = entPtsCC l (DFrac.own 1) c

theorem pbEntry_wire : pbEntry.wire = EntWireOk

theorem pbEntryC_blank (l : Loc) : pbEntryC.data.blank l = typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry)
    (DFrac.own 1)

theorem treeWp_entryTree [package_sem' : raftpb.Assumptions] [package_sem : Assumptions] (e :
    EntryM) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : (∀ x, (∀ p, typedPointsto p x (DFrac.own 1) ={⊤}=∗ ∃ c, entPtsCC
    p (DFrac.own 1) c ∗ ⌜c.model = e⌝) -∗ Φ (intoVal x)) ⊢ treeWp (entryTree e) Φ

theorem pbEntryC_marshals (e : EntryM) : pbEntryC.data.marshals e = True

def (sealed) entryEncC (c : EntryC) : List w8

theorem pbEntryC_size : pbEntryC.data.size = entrySize

theorem EntWireOk.inj {e e' : EntryM} {bs : List w8} (h : EntWireOk e bs) (h' : EntWireOk e' bs) : e
    = e'

theorem pbEntryC_C : pbEntryC.data.C = EntryC

theorem pbEntryC_modelOf : pbEntryC.data.modelOf = EntryC.model

theorem pbEncC_pbEntryC (c : EntryC) : pbEncC pbEntryC c = entryEncC c

theorem pbEntryC_decOk (c : EntryC) : pbEntryC.data.decOk c = True

theorem pbEntryC_roC : pbEntryC.data.roC = entRoC

    (DFrac.own 1) c ∗ ⌜c.model = e⌝)

theorem bytesC_freeze [package_sem' : raftpb.Assumptions] [package_sem : Assumptions] (ds : GoSlice)
    (xs : List w8) (h : xs = [] → ds = slice.nil) : ownSlice ds xs (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |==> ∃ o, bytesC
    ds o ∗ ⌜o.getD [] = xs⌝

theorem PbType.mk.congr_simp.{u_1} (ty ty✝ : go.GoType) (e_ty : ty = ty✝) (M : Type) (ro ro✝ : Loc →
    M → IProp GF) (e_ro : ro = ro✝) (ro_persistent : ∀ (l : Loc) (m : M), Persistent (ro l m))
    (marshals marshals✝ : M → Prop) (e_marshals : marshals = marshals✝) (wire wire✝ : M → List w8 →
    Prop) (e_wire : wire = wire✝) (eqv eqv✝ : M → M → Prop) (e_eqv : eqv = eqv✝) (blank blank✝ : Loc
    → IProp GF) (e_blank : blank = blank✝) (dec dec✝ : Loc → M → IProp GF) (e_dec : dec = dec✝) : {
    ty := ty, M := M, ro := ro, ro_persistent := ro_persistent, marshals := marshals, wire := wire,
    eqv := eqv, blank := blank, dec := dec } = { ty := ty✝, M := M, ro := ro✝, ro_persistent := ⋯,
    marshals := marshals✝, wire := wire✝, eqv := eqv✝, blank := blank✝, dec := dec✝ }
